summary: Deduplicated discussion signals: vendor agent releases (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), operator reports about agent mis-actions and pricing confusion, and emerging infra primitives for agent steering, memory, and MCP/eval. | Vendor announcements and security advisories affecting agent deployment, sandboxing, storage, and large-scale operator workflows. | GitHub-only snapshot: multiple vendor release updates (Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel, Qwen), plus notable infra primitives (trycua/cua, boxlite, mem0). No social/operator discussion found — gaps in user_workflow evidence. | Packages-only snapshot: several high-download VS Code extensions (OpenAI, Nexrall), vendor infra pieces (AWS, Vercel) and emerging MCP/sandbox/eval primitives. Missing social field reports and cross-platform corroboration for many single-repo packages.
